description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 该站以分类目录形式整理 AI 产品中的 UX 模式，首页按 Wayfinders、Inputs、Tuners、Governors、Trust builders、Identifiers 六类列出具体模式条目，如 Example gallery、Follow up、Initial CTA、Suggestions、Templates、Attachments、Citations、Watermark 等，每条附一句用途说明并可点入独立模式页；另设 About 介绍项目目标。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by The Shape of AI (https://www.shapeof.ai/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
